cache_dir.description: Directory where downloaded packages are cached. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#CacheDir    = /var/cache/pacman/pkg/).

clean_method.description: CleanMethod (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#CleanMethod = KeepInstalled).

db_path.description: Database path for pacman metadata. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#DBPath      = /var/lib/pacman/).

gpg_dir.description: Directory for GPG keys used by pacman. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#GPGDir      = /etc/pacman.d/gnupg/).

hold_pkg.description: HoldPkg (as documented in the shipped file).

hook_dir.description: Directory for pacman hooks. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#HookDir     = /etc/pacman.d/hooks/).

ignore_group.description: IgnoreGroup (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#IgnoreGroup =).

ignore_pkg.description: IgnorePkg (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#IgnorePkg   =).

local_file_sig_level.description: LocalFileSigLevel (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#LocalFileSigLevel = Optional).

log_file.description: Path to the pacman log file. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#LogFile     = /var/log/pacman.log).

no_extract.description: NoExtract (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#NoExtract   =).

no_upgrade.description: NoUpgrade (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#NoUpgrade   =).

parallel_downloads.description: Maximum number of simultaneous mirror downloads.

remote_file_sig_level.description: RemoteFileSigLevel (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#RemoteFileSigLevel = Optional).

root_dir.description: RootDir (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#RootDir     = /).
